name: Stem lanes (melon / pumpkin)
description: Stem rows on farmland with a free dirt block on both sides for the fruit; the path runs between two stem rows. SkyPilot reference layout derived from vanilla block-placement rules; it is not a copy of any community design. Check the Garden rules in-game before committing materials.
movement: Move to the next path (+Z by 8)
harvest_direction: Along X, breaking the fruit next to the path on both sides
water_notes: Water at z = 0, 8, 16, ... keeps every stem's farmland within 2 blocks of water.
build_order: Fruit only grows onto the free dirt blocks next to each stem: keep them empty.
